Class AuditMessage

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.audit.model.AuditMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Validateable
public class AuditMessage extends Object implements Serializable, Validateable
DICOM AuditMessage basis type. AuditMessage instances should always be built using BaseAuditMessageBuilder subclasses to ensure compliance with the specification.
Since:
3.5
Author:
Christian Ohr

      public JwtDataSet getJwtDataSet()

    • getRequestId

      public String getRequestId()
      Id correlating the audit records that the two ends of a transaction write about it. Kept alongside the participant object it was encoded into, because which participant object that is depends on the profile that asked for the correlation, while the value does not.
